ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/black pixels, with a dominant central dark vertical zone.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark vertical band extending from the peduncle attachment to the notch. Symmetrical high-intensity white regions occupying the central-distal areas of both lobes. Significant low-intensity mottling concentrated along the leading edges and a specific high-contrast dark jagged cluster on the right lobe's medial-posterior region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more pronounced, irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex posterior curvature with sharp, distinct upward-tapering distal tips (points).

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'salt-and-pepper' pixel transition zone between the central dark region and the white distal region on the right fluke lobe.
